jobs.title: Digital Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY**

The Digital Marketing Strategist is an individual contributor responsible for designing, executing, and optimizing multi\-channel campaigns that work seamlessly across digital and offline touchpoints. This role turns business goals into cohesive, full\-funnel strategies that connect paid, owned, and earned media to drive awareness, engagement, and conversion. This position contributes to website, digital marketing (including SEO), and social media efforts. This individual will work with the SVP of Marketing to proactively identify areas for campaign optimization. This is a highly cross\-functional role supporting a diverse set of initiatives, enabling collaboration with all levels and groups across the organization while remaining hands\-on.  


**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  


* **Education and/or Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in marketing or business administration or closely related fields of study, minimum of 7 years’ experience in marketing with a focus on digital channels.
* **Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:** None required.
* **Geographical Location:** This position may be eligible for a flexible work arrangement. **Individuals working in this position must be located within the state of California.**

  


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**
* Support a strong and consistent brand identity across all digital channels.
* Support digital strategy with execution across website, social media, email, and digital media channels, including SEO.
* Support alignment with business strategies and cross\-functional team communication objectives.

  


**Key Responsibilities:**  


**Integrated Campaign Strategy**
* Translate business objectives into integrated campaign strategies that align messaging, timing, and targeting across channels (web, email, social, search, display, content, and select offline).
* Develop clear campaign briefs outlining target audiences, value propositions, key messages, offers, channels, and measurement plans.
* Support end\-to\-end content production, working with external design resources to deliver content. Drive high\-quality creation of content for the website, social and email marketing campaigns.
* Review, write, and edit digital content for typographical, brand tone and voice, and graphic consistency – e.g., site content, SEO keywords and ad messaging, digital banner content, social posts.
* Work with digital agencies to develop content (both copy and images) that are aligned with brand strategy and business objectives.
* Implement digital marketing campaigns, ensuring alignment with brand identity and integration with traditional media marketing channels.
* Map campaigns to the customer journey, ensuring coordinated tactics for acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and retention.
* Recommend audience segmentation and personalization strategies to improve relevance and performance.

  


**Planning, Execution, and Orchestration**
* Partner with channel owners (email, paid media, social, web, events, branches/sales) to coordinate timelines and deliverables.
* Ensure creative concepts and assets are appropriately adapted for each channel while maintaining a cohesive campaign narrative.
* Optimize performance, identifying opportunities for campaign optimization and reinvestment of digital media.
* Oversee campaign setup and quality assurance (QA) across platforms, ensuring correct targeting, tracking, and deployment.

  


**Optimization and Performance Management**
* Recommend KPIs for each campaign and channel, aligned to funnel stages (reach, engagement, leads, applications, conversions, loyalty).
* Monitor performance regularly, identifying optimization opportunities across audiences, creative, messaging, and channel mix.
* Lead A/B and multivariate tests (subject lines, landing pages, calls to action (CTAs), formats) and document learnings for future campaigns.
* Prepare clear, actionable performance readouts with insights and recommendations for stakeholders.

  


**Collaboration and Stakeholder Alignment**
* Work closely with the SVP of Marketing to ensure campaigns support business and operational goals.
* Coordinate with creative teams to provide strategic direction, feedback, and context for assets and content.
* Partner with analytics/BI teams to refine attribution, reporting, and insight generation across channels.

  


**Governance, Process, and Best Practices**
* Maintain campaign and asset documentation, including briefs, timelines, and post\-campaign reports.
* Help standardize processes for intake, prioritization, approvals, and launch to improve speed and consistency.
* Ensure all campaigns follow brand guidelines, legal/compliance requirements, and data privacy standards.
* Stay current on digital marketing trends, emerging channels, and platform changes, bringing new ideas to test.
* Maintain working knowledge of regulatory compliance related to member services and financial services areas.
* Ensure that Mirastar’s brand and professional reputation are maintained across digital platforms.
* Resolve questions, requests, and problems courteously and within the given timeline.
* Provide project management support to ensure deadlines are met and perform other related duties as requested or assigned.
* Comply with the Bank Secrecy Act, OFAC, and USA PATRIOT Act, including but not limited to reporting suspicious activities to your supervisor and BSA Officer.

  


**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**
====================================


* Expertise in digital and direct marketing channels.
* Strong knowledge of how to use online analytical tools (Google Analytics, FB reporting, etc.).
* Must be able to anticipate project needs

If you enjoy working outdoors in a professional and safe environment, consider a career with Bartlett Tree Experts! At Bartlett, we value a strong culture of excellence in safety, scientific research, lifelong learning, and career development.  

Bartlett Tree Experts is currently seeking a full\-time Arborist Representative to join our growing team. jobs.title: Technical Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Sift**
--------------


Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high\-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission\-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.  

  

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
------------------


Sift's Business Development Representatives are the front line of our enterprise sales team. You'll own a portfolio of named accounts across aerospace, defense, and industrial engineering, building relationships with the teams designing rockets, satellites, autonomous systems, and other mission\-critical hardware.


This isn't mindless outbound. Success comes from curiosity, research, and good judgment. You'll learn how complex engineering organizations buy software, identify the right technical and executive stakeholders, and secure conversations through thoughtful, personalized outreach. You'll partner closely with an Account Executive to develop account strategy, travel to industry events and customer sites, and use AI\-assisted tooling to research accounts and scale high\-quality outreach.


As one of our early GTM hires, you'll work closely with sales leadership, gain exposure to full enterprise deal cycles, and build the technical and commercial foundation to grow into an Account Executive, sales leadership, or other GTM roles as you succeed.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own a portfolio of named accounts and drive the outreach strategy for each, from first touch to qualified meeting
* Map account org structures: identify decision\-makers, champions, and technical stakeholders across engineering, procurement, and program leadership
* Prioritize accounts using signals like funding, new leadership, program announcements, and industry news
* Identify new, unnamed opportunities: map emerging markets and adjacent verticals outside your assigned accounts, and make the case for where Sift should expand next
* Run personalized, multi\-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn) tailored to the technical buyer, not generic sequences
* Partner closely with your assigned AE: align on account strategy, keep pipeline visibility current, and ensure a clean handoff once a meeting is booked (join the first call as needed, but the AE owns prep)
* Keep CRM and account records current and accurate
* Travel to industry events and customer sites when it directly supports a named account
* Use AI\-assisted tooling to synthesize account research and draft outreach efficiently

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 1\-4 years in a customer\-facing, high\-performance environment (B2B sales development, consulting, program or capture support, or similar)
* Strong written communication; able to write outreach that reads as specific and researched, not templated
* Comfortable owning a portfolio and prioritizing without heavy oversight
* Highly self\-motivated, hardworking, and driven, with a track record of finding creative approaches when the obvious path doesn't work
* Genuine curiosity about hard tech, aerospace, defense, or industrial engineering
* Willing to travel for events and customer visits

**Bonus Points:**
-----------------

* Experience selling into or supporting government/defense programs
* Familiarity with account mapping or capture strategy in complex, multi\-stakeholder orgs
* Experience with Clarify, Salesforce, Apollo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

**Location:**
-------------


Sift’s headquarters is in **Marina Del Rey, CA** (Next to LAX). We collaborate **in person** twice a week—on **Mondays and Thursdays**—and come together for a full week every three months. We are open to **relocating candidates to LA** or **working from our San Francisco** office for the right candidate.


Salary range: $75,000 \- $125,000 base, plus $25,000\-$50,000 bonus per year, plus equity and benefits.

**Eligibility:**
----------------

**U.S. Person Required**: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.


Compensation Range: $75K \- $125K

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


**About the Team**

At Workday, we are transforming how businesses worldwide manage their operations. Our Sales Development team is at the heart of that mission. We are looking for individuals with a passion for strategic prospecting, a curiosity for creative thinking, and the motivation to help us advance Workday's mission together.
  

  

As part of our team, you will dive into the work of connecting with decision\-makers through phone and email, building meaningful relationships with potential clients. We introduce Workday's solutions to businesses and offer them new paths to operational efficiency and growth. We count on every team member to make that happen!
  

  

We are a collaborative community built on teamwork and forward thinking. We surround ourselves with industry experts and innovators, and we invest in each other's growth. We prioritize both personal and professional development because we believe that when our people grow, our team grows.
**About the Role**

As a Sales Development Representative, you will join our team in deploying various prospecting approaches across target accounts, partnering with our Account Executives to build quality opportunities for the Workday sales team. Your key role is to connect with potential customers and share our value messaging while also discovering the needs of the prospect and their organization.


Together, we generate a quality pipeline through a combination of email, phone calls, marketing qualified leads, social selling, and face\-to\-face events. We identify qualified potential buyers and develop the relationship between the account and our broader Workday team.

**Description**
---------------


Under the direction of an assigned supervisor, assist in the care and supervision of infants, preschool and school\-age children at an assigned childcare center or other learning environment; assist with planning and implementing a variety of activities to meet the needs and interests of the children; perform a variety of clerical support duties.


**Examples of Duties**
----------------------


ESSENTIAL DUTIES:


Assist in the care and supervision of infants, preschool and school\-age children at an assigned childcare center or other learning environment; assist in opening and closing assigned classroom; set up and put away toys, learning materials and equipment.


Assist with planning and implementing a variety of activities to meet the needs and interests of the children; assist children with homework and classroom assignments; read age\-appropriate stories to students; prepare classroom for naptime.


Perform a variety of clerical duties such as preparation of instructional materials, duplicating materials, taking attendance and maintaining student records and files.


Assure the health and safety of students by following established practices and procedures; maintain learning environment in a safe, orderly and clean manner; perform light housekeeping duties including washing dishes, clearing lunch tables, cleaning mats and workstations, sweeping floors and cleaning sinks.


Observe and control behavior of students in the classroom and during outdoor activities according to approved procedures; report progress regarding student performance and behavior; participate in parent conferences as assigned.


Assist students regarding the building of self\-esteem; assist students by providing proper examples, emotional support, friendly attitude and general guidance; respond to a child's needs and problems in a patient, caring and sensitive manner.


Assist with snack and lunch time as assigned; escort children to the cafeteria for breakfast as assigned; clean up eating areas and wash children's hands and faces after play times and meals as needed; assist children with toileting as needed, change diapers and soiled clothing as needed.


Oversee groups of children in games and play activities; assure safe outdoor play; accompany students on field trips as assigned; administer basic first aid as needed.


Interpret and explain classroom activities to parents and visitors including techniques of individual instruction and small group instruction in the areas of manipulative play, creative art, block building, dramatic play, science and language arts.


Operate a variety of classroom and office equipment including a computer, copier, audio\-visual equipment.

Attend and participate in a variety of in\-service trainings, staff meetings and childcare center functions.


Perform related duties as assigned.

Basic principles and practices of early child development including proper care and discipline.


Child guidance principles and practices.


Safe practices in classroom and playground activities.


Basic subjects taught in District schools, including arithmetic, grammar, spelling, language and reading.


Basic instructional methods and techniques.


Correct English usage, grammar, spelling, punctuation and vocabulary.


Classroom procedures and appropriate student conduct.


Operation of standard office and classroom equipment.


Oral and written communication skills.


Interpersonal skills using tact, patience and courtesy.


Basic record\-keeping techniques.


ABILITY TO:


Provide quality child care and a safe environment for children in an assigned child care center or other learning environment.


Assist with instruction and related activities in a classroom or assigned learning environment.


Reinforce instruction to individual or small groups of students as directed by the teacher.


Understand and follow oral and written directions.


Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others.


Be flexible to perform work within changing priorities and possess sufficient interpersonal skill to work harmoniously with staff, students, administrators, parents and others.


Communicate effectively both orally and in writing.


Monitor, observe and report student behavior and progress according to approved policies and procedures.


Operate standard office and classroom equipment.


Observe health and safety regulations.


Perform clerical duties related to classroom activities.


Maintain routine records.


Learn first aid and CPR techniques.

--------------------------

Any combination equivalent to: graduation from high school and completion of (6\) or more semester units of ECE or child development for Level I and completion of (12\) or more semester units of ECE or child development and an Associate Teacher Permit for Level II.

Valid First Aid and CPR Certificate issued by an authorized agency within six months of employment for Level I and at the time of hiring for Level II.

ENVIRONMENT:


Classroom and playground environment.

Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate classroom equipment.


Sitting or standing for extended periods of time.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Our Company:** Originally founded in 1975, BCI has continually evolved to become a leader in the women’s fashion industry. Launching initially with CHAUS and private label lines and then expanding into a multi\-brand platform business, we have been at the forefront of market trends and the changing retail environment.


Our brands, including CeCe, Vince Camuto, Ted Baker, 1\.State and Parker, each serve unique customer demographics but are united in their commitment to quality and style. As we expand our presence, BCI remains dedicated to innovation, excellence, and women’s empowerment through fashion.

**THE ROLE:**


We are seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented **Logistics Coordinator** to join our Logistics team. The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in international logistics and experience coordinating shipments from vendors/factories through final delivery.


This role is highly collaborative and requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple shipments, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously. The Logistics Coordinator will work closely with freight forwarders, overseas vendors/factories, and internal departments including Production, Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure shipments move efficiently and arrive on time.


In addition to core logistics responsibilities, this position will support our GS1 program, UCC\-128 carton labeling, cartonization, and factory coordination, making this an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to expand their logistics expertise within the apparel industry.

**Ideal Candidate**


The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of shipments from start to finish. They should be confident communicating with vendors and logistics partners, while also being able to work effectively with multiple internal departments.


Most importantly, this person should have a strong logistics coordination foundation and be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly. Experience with GS1/UCC\-128, cartonization, and factory operations is a strong advantage, but the ability to learn and grow in these areas is equally important.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Shipment \& Logistics Management*

* Track and monitor international and domestic shipments from origin through final delivery.
* Maintain accurate shipment status updates and proactively identify potential delays or issues.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, carriers, customs brokers, 3PL warehouses, and other logistics partners.
* Follow up with vendors/factories regarding shipment readiness, booking information, ETDs, ETAs, documentation, and delivery requirements.
* Review shipping documentation for accuracy and completeness.
* Communicate shipment delays, changes, and exceptions to the appropriate internal teams.
* Ensure shipments meet required delivery dates and company guidelines.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and provide regular reporting and updates to the Logistics team.

*Vendor \& Factory Coordination*

* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with overseas vendors and factories.
* Communicate directly with factories regarding shipping requirements, production readiness, carton information, and documentation.
* Work closely with vendors to resolve shipment discrepancies, delays, documentation issues, and other logistics\-related concerns.
* Ensure factories understand and follow company shipping and labeling requirements.
* Partner with Production and other teams to align factory readiness with shipping timelines.
* *Cross\-Functional Communication*
* Work closely with internal departments including Production, Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, and Logistics to ensure accurate and timely flow of information.
* Provide shipment updates and relevant information to internal stakeholders.
* Assist with resolving issues that impact customer delivery dates, inventory availability, or financial processing.
* Serve as a key point of contact between internal teams, vendors, and logistics service providers.

*GS1 / UCC\-128 Program*

* Support and maintain the company’s GS1/UCC\-128 carton labeling program.
* Coordinate with vendors/factories to ensure carton labels are created and applied according to company and customer requirements.
* Review and troubleshoot UCC\-128 label issues and work with factories to correct discrepancies.
* Assist with cartonization of goods, including carton quantities \& ensure compliance within the guidelines of the program.
* Work closely with factories to ensure cartonization and labeling information is accurate before goods ship.
* Help ensure carton information aligns with purchase orders, shipping documentation, and customer requirements.

  

**Requirements**  

* **2\+ years of experience in logistics, transportation,** supply chain, or a related field, preferably in an apparel environment.
* Strong foundation in logistics coordination and shipment tracking.
* Experience working with freight forwarders, vendors, factories, and/or carriers.
* Experience with international shipping and familiarity with import processes preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external teams.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with GS1, UCC\-128 labeling, or retail carton labeling requirements.
* Experience with cartonization, carton packing information, or factory packing compliance.
* Experience working directly with overseas apparel factories.
* Familiarity with ERP systems.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
============


Green Top Farms is a New York\-based food service company specializing in farm\-fresh meals for enterprise workplace dining and corporate catering. We partner with leading companies to deliver elevated daily dining and hospitality experiences, using seasonal ingredients and thoughtful operations to create consistent, high\-quality service at scale.


Our mission is to build a more sustainable and equitable food system, starting by reconnecting consumers and local farmers. We believe the results of strengthening that connection are better nutrition, tastier food, greater social justice, and reduced environmental impacts. Our menus reflect this attention to bringing nutritious, delicious food to those who need it most.

**Position Overview**
=====================


The Sales Coordinator is an entry\-level role that keeps our sales and business development engine organized and moving. You will provide the administrative backbone for an experienced sales team, handling the coordination, data, and follow\-through that let our senior sellers focus on clients and growth. You will work closely with and learn directly from our CEO and Biz Dev Manager, gaining hands\-on exposure to how enterprise dining and catering accounts are won and grown.


This is a strong fit for someone early in their career or changing careers into sales. We are looking for a candidate who is:

* Highly organized, reliable, and detail\-oriented
* Eager to learn sales and business development from the ground up
* Comfortable owning administrative work that keeps a team on track
* A clear communicator who follows through without being chased


The ideal candidate brings energy and coachability, takes ownership of the details, and wants to grow into a client\-facing sales or account role over time.

* Grow toward a client\-facing sales or account role.
* Shadow the CEO and Biz Dev Manager on calls, meetings, and pitches
* Take notes, capture action items, and complete follow\-ups
* Build product, menu, and market knowledge over time

### **Cross\-Functional \& General Support (10%)**

* Support the broader team as priorities require.
* Coordinate with operations, culinary, and account management on shared work
* Assist with catering and event support as needed
* Take on additional administrative duties that help the sales team succeed

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 0 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent transferable experience from another field
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable using Google Workspace or Microsoft Office
* Genuine eagerness to learn sales and business development
* A commitment to personal accountability and continuous learning
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment

**Preferred Qualifications**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Interest in food service, hospitality, or sustainability
* Familiarity with a CRM platform (HubSpot preferred)
* Experience with project management software (Asana preferred)
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

**Key Competencies**
----------------------------------------------------------------
* Organization and follow\-through
* Clear and proactive communication
* Eagerness to learn and coachability
* Reliability and ownership
* Cross\-functional collaboration

Role Details
---------------------------------------------

**Location:** New York City

**Schedule:** Monday through Friday. Occasional evenings or weekends for events based on business needs

**Reports to:** Director of Business, with day\-to\-day mentorship from the CEO and Biz Dev Manager

**About On Board Experiential (OBE)**



OBE is a global marketing agency that brings brands to life through culture\-shaping experiences. For more than 30 years, we've partnered with iconic brands — including Nike, the NFL, JPMorganChase, Meta, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse — to build community, create cultural relevance, and drive measurable business impact. With offices in Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, and London, we activate globally. OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.



We've been recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events — and we couldn't agree more.



The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative, and make genuinely remarkable things happen. But behind every great activation is a human who deserves rest, connection, and a life outside of work. That's why we invest in recovery days, company offsites, happy hours, and the kind of friendly\-but\-competitive fitness challenges that bond teams for life.



We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences, your unconventional ideas, and the perspectives only you can bring. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.


**Summary of Position**



The Account Coordinator is an integral part of the team responsible for the successful management, support, and production of our experiential programs. Reporting to a senior Account team member, this person performs essential coordination duties across the planning, development, activation, and wrap\-up stages of both client programs and internal agency initiatives.



For this entry\-level role, we are looking for a enthusiastic professional with a strong passion for lifestyle brands spanning restaurants, dining culture, travel \& hospitality, retail pop\-ups, and brand sponsorships. The Account Coordinator helps ensure the highest quality of service across client deliverables, keeping projects organized and executed with professionalism, accuracy, and timeliness.


**Essential Job Functions**


* **Project \& Team Administration:** Prepare client\-facing and internal materials, status documents, meeting agendas, and weekly recaps.
* **Lifestyle \& Sponsorship Research:** Assist with research and audit decks covering cultural trends, competitive lifestyle campaigns, venue scouting (restaurants, hotels, retail spaces), and potential brand sponsorship opportunities.
* **Deliverable Tracking:** Support the tracking of timelines and deliverables across cross\-functional teams (Production, Creative, Strategy, Tech), keeping core project management trackers updated in real time.
* **Meeting Facilitation \& Action Items:** Participate in weekly internal and client status meetings, capturing detailed notes, action items, and next steps for prompt distribution.
* **Pre\-Production Support:** Ensure assigned areas of program planning—such as vendor outreach, retail/merchandise sourcing, restaurant reservation coordination, and sample tracking—are completed on schedule.
* **Onsite Event Execution:** Assist with ground\-level logistics, sponsor activation booths, VIP hospitality check\-ins, retail display setups, and brand ambassador coordination during live event executions.
* **Post\-Event Wrap\-Up:** Participate in event debriefs, gathering photo/video assets to build client recap decks and compile performance metrics for KPI reporting.
* **Agency Culture \& Initiatives:** Join or lead internal agency committees, cultural task forces, and department offsite planning.


**Desired Skills and Experiences**


**Education \& Experience**


* **BA/BS** in marketing, business administration, hospitality, communications, or a related field.
* **Experience** in marketing, promotions, hospitality, or events (including hands\-on, onsite event execution experience). Experiential marketing agency experience is a plus.
* **Demonstrated Interest in Lifestyle Culture:** A strong passion for and baseline understanding of lifestyle categories, including food \& dining trends, hotel/travel experiences, retail activations, and sports or cultural sponsorships.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with internal teams, venue partners, and clients.
* **Detail \& Organization:** Exceptional organizational skills, high accuracy, and strong attention to detail when managing calendars, spreadsheets, and run\-of\-shows.
* **Multitasking:** Ability to navigate competing priorities and tight deadlines with agility in a fast\-paced agency environment.
* **Collaborative Mindset:** A proactive team player who works well independently and collaboratively within cross\-functional groups.


**Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**


* **Cultural \& Digital Pulse:** Up\-to\-date knowledge of social media trends, viral pop\-culture moments, lifestyle influencers, and emerging retail/dining concepts.
* **Brand Integrity:** Basic understanding of brand management standards, ensuring client brand guidelines are consistently upheld across event collateral, sponsor signage, and onsite environments.
* **Relationship Building:** Ability to connect with clients, vendors, and team members authentically while respecting diverse perspectives.
* **Creative Curiosity:** Willingness to bring fresh, creative ideas to brainstorms and extend beyond basic assignments to drive innovation.


**Other Qualities and Requirements**


* **Natural Curiosity:** A drive to constantly learn and explore emerging trends across travel, dining, retail, and experiential marketing.
* **Schedule Flexibility:** High energy and willingness to work non\-traditional hours (including evenings and weekends as event schedules demand).
* **Physical Capability:** Ability to lift up to 25 pounds

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Events
jobs.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest\-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean\-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.


Despite being a $1\.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de\-risk projects, and scale with confidence.


As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.


We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top\-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

**Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in\-office days per week). We prefer NYC\-based candidates or those open to relocation.**

**About the Role**
==================


We've built the foundation for events at PermitFlow. Now we need someone to own the outcome and turn events into a pillar of our GTM motion.


This role runs the full events portfolio: industry conferences, owned events, customer\-specific gatherings, and field marketing, plus ongoing experimentation with new formats, venues, and audiences. You'll execute hands\-on, with internal and external support, and tie every event back to pipeline and revenue goals. We're an experimentation\-heavy culture. You'll be given room to ideate, experiment, measure, and repeat what works.


This is a manager\-level individual contributor role. You already know how to set goals, manage a budget, and partner across teams, and you'll bring that experience on day one.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Own the events portfolio: build the calendar across industry events, owned events, customer events, and field marketing, and decide where to place bets.
* Run logistics end to end: venues, budgets, vendors, contractors, staffing, and the on\-the\-ground run of show.
* Experiment deliberately and iterate quickly: test new formats, venues, and target audiences, and kill what doesn't work.
* Get the right targets in the room and at our booth. Great events don't stop at a project plan; they rely on driving high\-value attendees.
* Connect events to revenue: define what success looks like for each event, track pipeline and revenue impact, and report results back to the business.
* Partner cross\-functionally: work closely with demand gen, product marketing, sales, CS, and business operations to align events with GTM priorities.
* Manage event budgets and vendor relationships: negotiate contracts, manage contractor relationships, and keep spend accountable.
* Build the playbook: turn what's worked into repeatable processes so the program scales as the business grows.
* Represent events at the leadership level: bring recommendations and results directly to company leadership.
* Source speaking opportunities at relevant industry and public events for executive leadership, including content submissions as needed.

**Who You Are**
===============

* You've run B2B events in a fast\-moving environment and know the difference between an event that just looks good and one that drives pipeline.
* You can run logistics yourself. You don't need a coordinator to book a venue or manage a floor plan, but you know when and what to delegate.
* You think like a marketer first and an event planner second: every event ties back to organizational goals.
* You've worked closely with partners in Sales, Customer Success, and Executives.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. This program is evolving, and you'll be instrumental in building the playbooks and processes.
* Bonus: experience in construction, home services, or a related built\-world industry.
* Bonus: experience at a startup or in AI, and genuine interest in how physical infrastructure gets built.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high\-growth company
* 100% company\-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees \+ healthcare FSA
* 401(k) savings plan
* Unlimited PTO and paid family leave
* Home office \& equipment stipend
* Daily in\-office lunch and dinner provided
* Commuter benefits (pre\-tax transit and parking)

*PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.*

 *We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.*


Compensation Range: $120K \- $150K

jobs.description:
**About On Board Experiential (OBE)**



OBE is a global marketing agency that brings brands to life through culture\-shaping experiences. For more than 30 years, we've partnered with iconic brands — including Nike, the NFL, JPMorganChase, Meta, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse — to build community, create cultural relevance, and drive measurable business impact. With offices in Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, and London, we activate globally. OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.



We've been recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events — and we couldn't agree more.



The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative, and make genuinely remarkable things happen. But behind every great activation is a human who deserves rest, connection, and a life outside of work. That's why we invest in recovery days, company offsites, happy hours, and the kind of friendly\-but\-competitive fitness challenges that bond teams for life.



We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences, your unconventional ideas, and the perspectives only you can bring. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.


**Summary of Position**



The Account Manager (Account Lead) is an integral part of the Account Team, delivering an exceptional level of service, strategic vision, and flawless execution of experiential programs on behalf of our clients. Responsible for cultivating and expanding client accounts, this position requires a comprehensive understanding of our clients' business needs, industry trends, and specialized experiential environments.



For this role, we are seeking an Account Lead with a strong background in hospitality, restaurant management, and food \& beverage programs. You will bring deep operational command of both Front of House guest experience and Back of House kitchen/culinary logistics, with a heavy emphasis on high\-end dining execution. This position requires a proven track record of managing multi\-partner culinary activations, including the capability to oversee up to 30 individual restaurant or hospitality partners within a single event. Providing end\-to\-end project management and accountability for financial and operational performance, the Account Manager ensures that programs successfully promote client brands while delivering world\-class hospitality standards.


**Essential Job Functions**


* **Strategic Client Partnership:** Partner with client and brand teams to understand business objectives, identifying opportunities to offer innovative experiential solutions. Specifically leveraging F\&B, culinary integration, and hospitality\-driven touchpoints to drive measurable results.
* **Large\-Scale Hospitality Partner Management:** Direct vendor relationships and operational onboarding for complex, multi\-vendor culinary activations, managing up to 30 individual restaurant, chef, or hospitality partners per event.
* **FOH \& BOH Operations Integration:** Bridge Front of House service standards (guest flow, table service, VIP hospitality, bar pacing) with Back of House kitchen realities (staging areas, prep timelines, cold storage, equipment load\-in, waste management, and chef coordination) with a primary emphasis on dining excellence.
* **Experiential \& F\&B Program Planning:** Guide and coordinate the development of Experiential tactical plans for live, hybrid, and culinary\-focused activations in partnership with Strategy/Creative, Production, Tech, Digital, Social, and Culinary Operations teams.
* **Regulatory \& Permitting Oversight:** Serve as the primary Account Lead for venue buyouts, restaurant partnerships, bar program builds, menu development, staffing protocols, and temporary health/liquor permitting compliance across all participating culinary partners.
* **Day\-to\-Day Account Skills:** Manage day\-to\-day project activities, providing clear direction and seamless execution across internal cross\-functional teams, external vendors, master mixologists, Executive Chefs, FOH leads, and venue owners.
* **Communication \& Meeting Facilitation:** Lead weekly client status meetings, deep dives, and post\-event debriefs. Direct the proper distribution of all project communications, timelines, run\-of\-shows (ROS), Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), and kitchen load\-in schedules throughout the engagement.
* **Financial Management \& Budgeting:** Provide ongoing monitoring of expenses, vendor contracts, culinary talent fees, and actual costs for approved program budgets. Obtain client approvals, manage scope changes, and reconcile all project expenses in partnership with the Program Producer.
* **Performance Feedback \& Quality Control:** Provide timely performance feedback on all activations, catering partners, and internal team members to senior management, maintaining white\-glove dining standards across all touchpoints.


**Desired Skills and Experiences**


**Education \& Experience**


* **3\+ years of experience** in marketing, promotions, live events, or experiential marketing (agency experience strongly preferred).
* **Minimum 2 years of experience as an Account Lead**, acting as the primary point of client contact.
* **Demonstrated experience in hospitality and dining operations**, including direct experience managing both Front of House service and Back of House kitchen logistics.
* **Proven track record of managing large\-scale culinary activations**, specifically coordinating multi\-vendor footprints featuring up to 30 distinct restaurant, chef, or bar partners simultaneously.
* Experience managing live events, hospitality suites, food festivals, pop\-up dining concepts, and high\-volume experiential activations.
* BA/BS in marketing, hospitality management, business administration,

**Description**
---------------


This role is for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) on the Zappos FBA Preferred Partnerships team. The position is a new headcount designed to serve as a dedicated strategic growth partner for assigned footwear brands within our Preferred Partnership Program (PPP).
  

  

The CSM will operate as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisor for their brand portfolio, personally engaging with vendor stakeholders to develop trust, influence strategic decisions, and align brand goals with Amazon growth opportunities. This role requires navigating complex multi\-stakeholder environments, influencing without authority across internal teams (Buying \& Planning, Supply Chain, Advertising), and building durable partnerships through consistent personal engagement, transparent communication, and accountable follow\-through.
  

  

This role is highly visible and requires a balance of tactical execution and strategic relationship management. Success in this role means earning the trust of brand partners through reliable personal engagement, driving selection growth through coordinated investment, and strengthening the scalability of the PPP through accountable partnership ownership.
  

  

Key job responsibilities
  

Partnership Ownership \& Relationship Management: Serve as the dedicated point of contact for assigned footwear brands, building trusted advisory relationships through regular touchpoints, proactive communication, and responsive issue resolution. Engage with brand stakeholders to understand their business objectives and translate them into actionable growth strategies. Maintain defined response SLAs and conduct quarterly Partnership Health Reviews.
  

  

Strategic Growth \& Business Planning: Develop Joint Business Plans with buyers and vendors to align growth priorities and partnership commitments. Create one\-page Brand Growth Briefs covering demand signals, whitespace opportunities, and exclusivity strategies. Attend market appointments to influence buy depth and surface growth opportunities with brand decision\-makers.
  

  

Demand Acceleration \& Investment Coordination: Coordinate Sponsored Ads, merchandising, promotions, and catalog optimization to drive traffic, conversion, and organic rank growth. Manage deal mechanics and identify cost\-engineered opportunities for event eligibility.
  

  

Controlled Distribution \& Customer Experience: Monitor seller fragmentation, Featured Offer ownership, and pricing consistency. Coordinate Brand Store, A\+ Content, and catalog updates to improve listing quality and customer trust.
  

  

Reporting \& Operational Excellence: Deliver monthly Brand Exposure Reports and weekly business recaps. Build scalable reporting and process improvements to support program growth.
  

  

A day in the life
  

Your day might start reviewing Featured Offer trends and seller fragmentation for a Priority Partner, then shift to coordinating a Sponsored Ads campaign launch with the media team. Mid\-morning, you're on a call with a brand stakeholder discussing their quarterly growth plan. After lunch, you're preparing a one\-page exclusivity brief for an upcoming market appointment, then submitting deal mechanics for a high\-velocity event. You close the day delivering a vendor digest and flagging pricing risks to the buying team. No two days look the same, but every day connects brand strategy to measurable Amazon outcomes.
  

  

About the team
  

The Preferred Partnerships Program (PPP) is a growth and distribution management team within Zappos FBA team. We serve as strategic partners to premium footwear brands, helping them grow on Amazon through controlled distribution, coordinated advertising investment, and accountable ownership. Our Customer Success Managers work alongside Buying \& Planning to accelerate demand, expand exclusivity, optimize Featured Offer performance, and improve the customer experience. We manage a tiered portfolio of Priority, Growth, and Emerging partners, scaling investment and support based on each brand's strategic value and commitment level.

* 2\+ years in a client\-facing role within Customer Success, Account Management, Buying, Merchandising, or Strategic Partnerships owning external client/vendor relationships
* Proven ability to build trusted advisory relationships with external stakeholders
* Track record driving measurable partner outcomes (revenue growth, operational improvements, or adoption)

* Experience presenting data\-backed business reviews to stakeholders
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**



We're a full\-service creative shop born out of ATTN:'s purpose\-driven mission to bring attention to the things that matter. We exist to build brands for the attention era. We accelerate growth for brands, putting them at the center of culture so they become the center of attention. We are a diverse group of entrepreneurial spirits, creative minds and makers and we're lucky enough to work with some of the world's most innovative brands and culturally connected brands.


**What We Are Looking For:**



As a Community Manager in a highly regulated sector like healthcare, finance, or legal tech, you hold a vital role in shaping how our brand connects online. Reporting to the Strategy Director, your mission is to build a thriving community from the ground up by establishing deep trust, swiftly addressing audience issues, and ensuring absolute alignment with strict regulatory compliance. You prove that a regulated brand can still be a cultural leader; you're as comfortable navigating data privacy and sensitive disclosures as you are centering the brand in internet culture, trends, and daily conversations. Equal parts charismatic storyteller (think "Most Friendly" on\-camera energy) and protective brand guardian, you are the essential bridge that allows us to engage authentically.


**What You'll Do**



Community Leadership and Hosting


* Manage a large community (e.g., 1,000\+ social media users) within a social platform.
* Set and maintain the vibes of the community, helping members form connections and collaborate.
* Serve as moderator for daily communications, responding promptly to questions and escalations, ensuring that conversations are collaborative, positive, and aligned to platform guidelines.
* Identify trending conversations and topics relevant to the community.
* Ideate and post daily discussion threads and weekly content challenges.
* Assist in reporting on monthly community themes, topics, and events.
* Maintain high energy and facilitate participation across diverse audiences.


Regulatory Compliance and Risk Management


* Review and approve community messaging across member communications, user\-generated content (UGC), and campaigns to ensure compliance with applicable regulations (e.g., HIPAA, FINRA) and company policies.
* Monitor community platforms for potential compliance breaches, misinformation, or liability risks; implement rapid mitigation, documentation, and escalation processes.

* Develop clear educational materials, house rules, and community guidelines; establish a transparent environment where members understand boundaries, privacy expectations, and disclosure requirements.


Program Strategy, Insights, and Social Strategy


* Design and execute long\-term community programs (e.g., user forums, advisory boards, advocacy groups) that deliver value and remain within industry guidelines.
* Track engagement metrics and community health; partner with Media Operations and Legal to measure impact, inform risk posture, and optimize strategies and workflows.
* Stay abreast of popular creators, original sounds, memes, and platform trends; proactively share relevant insights with teams and clients, especially on leading platforms' audiences.
* Continuously develop and improve procedures that lead to more strategic plans and/or workflow improvements.
* Collaborate with Account Management and Media Operations on case studies for campaigns, trends, or overall partnerships; assist in creating content and compliance reports.

  


**Qualifications**


* 3–5\+ years of experience in community management, public relations, or digital strategy, ideally within a heavily regulated sector; experience establishing and growing virtual communities.
* Experience working with creator programs.
* Deep understanding of relevant compliance standards, data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and disclosure requirements; familiarity with industry\-specific regulations (e.g., HIPAA, FINRA) and UGC moderation best practices.
* Strong ability to foresee potential PR and legal pitfalls; exercises sound independent judgment under pressure and during crisis or escalation scenarios.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; able to distill complex, highly technical, or legal concepts into engaging, accessible community language.
* Ability to anticipate messaging needs, be proactive, and meet fast deadlines.
* Ability to understand cultural issues and explain them verbally and in writing across different styles; able to identify audience\-specific trends, threats, and opportunities on social platforms.
* Passion for great storytelling as it relates to Gen Z and Millennial audiences.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively interact with individuals across all levels, backgrounds, lived experiences, and perspectives.
* Strong understanding of key performance drivers and ability to execute against findings.
* Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

Opentrons Labworks, Inc. is a disruptive life science company leveraging its integrated lab platform to supercharge the pace of innovation in research and healthcare. Through Opentrons Robotics, thousands of institutions are automating lab operations with flexible, easy\-to\-use liquid handling lab robots. Opentrons is growing rapidly, and we’re seeking a senior digital marketing leader to own both the strategy and the day\-to\-day execution of our global demand generation and digital growth engine. This is a dual mandate: set the digital marketing strategy (channel mix, investment priorities, and expected outcomes) and personally run the systems and programs (paid media, email and lifecycle marketing, HubSpot, website conversion) that deliver on it.

You’ll partner closely with Marketing and Sales to align digital investment with pipeline and revenue targets, then execute directly. Website \& Conversion Optimization:* Ensure digital traffic converts efficiently into pipeline.
* Drive CRO initiatives including landing page strategy, form optimization, personalization, and conversion path testing.
* Ensure analytics, tracking, and integrations are accurately implemented across all digital touchpoints.


Contractor \& Agency Management:* Own all digital contractor and agency relationships end to end, serving as the primary point of contact for scope, deliverables, budget, and performance.
* Manage SOWs and budgets, setting clear performance expectations and evaluating output to recommend scope changes, renewals, or new vendors.
* Manage specialized external partners (web dev, paid media, CRO, HubSpot admins, creative/video vendors) to deliver campaign assets and technical builds.

 **Who We’re Looking For**
Education:* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.


Experience:* 5–7 years of experience in digital marketing, marketing operations, CRM management, or related roles, including experience setting strategy and reporting to senior stakeholders.
* Experience with HubSpot or another CRM/marketing automation platform, and CMS tools (e.g., Webflow, WordPress, or similar).

**About BlueMatrix:**
BlueMatrix is the market\-leading platform for content creation, distribution, and compliance in the investment research industry. We support many of the world’s top banks, asset managers, and independent research providers, enabling them to publish high\-quality research efficiently and securely. As we expand our reach into new markets and industries, we’re looking for a motivated and ambitious Business Development Representative to help fuel our growth.

**The Role:**
As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be on the front lines of our sales organization, responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential clients. You will play a critical role in creating pipeline for our Account Executives by proactively sourcing new business opportunities, responding to inbound interest, and booking high\-quality meetings. This is a foundational role with clear career progression into sales, marketing, or customer success.
### **Responsibilities:**

* Identify and research high\-potential target accounts and key decision\-makers across financial institutions, research firms, and asset management companies.
* Drive outbound prospecting efforts through a mix of cold calls, personalized email outreach, LinkedIn engagement, and social selling strategies.
* Proactively follow up on marketing\-generated leads from webinars, events, and digital campaigns to convert interest into qualified opportunities.
* Respond promptly and professionally to inbound leads and inquiries, ensuring a seamless prospect experience.
* Qualify leads using the BANT framework (Budget, Authority, Need, and Timeline) to assess fit and readiness for engagement.
* Collaborate closely with Account Executives to route and hand off qualified opportunities, ensuring smooth transitions through the sales funnel.


**Meeting Booking \& Sales Support**
* Secure and schedule discovery calls and demos for the sales team
* Maintain detailed records of activities, touchpoints, and conversations in the CRM (e.g., Salesforce or HubSpot)
* Collaborate with Account Executives and Marketing to refine messaging and optimize outreach strategies


**Performance Tracking \& Growth**
* Meet and exceed weekly/monthly KPIs including calls, emails, meetings booked, and opportunities created
* Continuously learn about BlueMatrix’s products, industry trends, and client challenges
* Participate in team trainings, sales meetings, and cross\-functional projects to grow your skills

### **Job Requirements:**

* 1–2 years of experience in a BDR, SDR, or sales\-related role (B2B SaaS or FinTech experience is a plus)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable with cold outreach and high\-volume prospecting
* Organized, self\-motivated, and eager to learn
* Experience using CRM and sales engagement tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo)
* Knowledge of financial services, capital markets, or research workflows is a bonus

Base salary plus generous commission opportunities for meeting or exceeding targets.**WHAT WE DO**
BlueMatrix develops one\-of\-a\-kind web applications for the authoring, distribution, and analysis of investment research, and for internal knowledge management and digital communications. Our mission is to streamline the publishing process on a global scale.

**WHY WORK WITH US**
The BlueMatrix team is made up of ambitious and passionate people who have turned technology development and client service into an art. Many have dedicated the majority of their career to growing the BlueMatrix brand and helping shape the investment research marketplace.
With locations in New York City, Durham, London, Edinburgh, and Timisoara, Romania, we collaborate across the globe for a unique perspective on the impact of technology in our industry.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented **Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC)** to support the successful conduct of clinical research studies at our site.

  

The Clinical Research Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating day\-to\-day study activities from study start\-up through closeout, ensuring that clinical trials are conducted safely, efficiently, and in accordance with the study protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), applicable regulations, and site standard operating procedures.  

The ideal candidate is dependable, comfortable working directly with patients and investigators, able to manage multiple studies simultaneously, and takes ownership of study timelines, documentation, and follow\-up.

 **Key Responsibilities:**


Study Coordination:

* Coordinate assigned clinical research studies from site initiation through study closeout.
* Review and maintain familiarity with study protocols, informed consent forms, manuals, schedules of assessments, and study\-specific procedures.
* Prepare for and coordinate screening, enrollment, randomization, treatment, and follow\-up visits.
* Ensure all study procedures are completed within protocol\-required timeframes.
* Maintain accurate study calendars, visit schedules, task lists, and patient follow\-up.

  

Participant Management

* Pre\-screen potential participants against study inclusion and exclusion criteria.
* Coordinate participant screening and enrollment activities.
* Conduct or assist with the informed consent process under the direction of the Principal Investigator.
* Educate participants regarding study expectations, visit requirements, and study procedures.
* Maintain regular communication with study participants and help promote participant retention.
* Coordinate transportation, appointment reminders, and other participant logistics when applicable.
* Document participant interactions accurately and contemporaneously.

 **Clinical Study Visits:**

* Conduct protocol\-required study visits within the coordinator's scope of practice and training.
* Obtain and document vital signs, medical history, concomitant medications, and other protocol\-required information.
* Perform or coordinate ECGs, phlebotomy, specimen collection, processing, packaging, and shipment when applicable and appropriately trained.
* Administer questionnaires, scales, diaries, and other study assessments as required by the protocol.
* Coordinate study\-related procedures with investigators, laboratories, pharmacies, imaging facilities, and outside medical providers.

 **Source Documentation \& Data Entry:**

* Maintain complete, accurate, attributable, legible, contemporaneous, original, and accurate source documentation.
* Enter study data into Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems accurately and within required timelines.
* Review source documents and electronic case report forms for completeness and consistency.
* Respond promptly to sponsor and CRO data queries.
* Maintain study\-specific logs, including screening, enrollment, delegation, training, temperature, and investigational product logs as applicable.

 **Safety Reporting**

* Identify and document adverse events and serious adverse events in accordance with study requirements.
* Promptly communicate safety information to the Principal Investigator.
* Assist with sponsor, CRO, IRB, and regulatory reporting of safety events within required timelines.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of adverse event follow\-up.

 **Regulatory \& Compliance**

* Conduct studies in compliance with:
* Study protocols
* ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP)
* FDA regulations
* Institutional Review Board (IRB) requirements
* Sponsor/CRO requirements
* Site Standard Operating Procedures
* Assist with maintaining complete and audit\-ready regulatory and study files.
* Ensure required training documentation and delegation records remain current.
* Report protocol deviations appropriately and assist with corrective and preventive actions when necessary.

 **Sponsor \& Monitor Communication:**

* Serve as a primary operational contact for assigned studies.
* Communicate professionally with sponsors, CROs, monitors, investigators, laboratories, vendors, and other study partners.
* Prepare for and participate in:
* Site Qualification Visits
* Site Initiation Visits
* Interim Monitoring Visits
* Remote Monitoring Visits
* Closeout Visits
* Sponsor audits and regulatory inspections
* Resolve monitoring findings and follow\-up items within required timelines.

 **Investigational Product \& Study Supplies:**

* Coordinate investigational product accountability and storage when delegated and appropriately trained.
* Maintain study supplies and ensure required materials are available for scheduled visits.
* Monitor expiration dates and storage requirements.
* Coordinate receipt, inventory, return, or destruction of study materials as applicable.

  

Recruitment Support

* Work closely with recruitment staff to identify potentially eligible participants.
* Review pre\-screening information and determine whether candidates should proceed to formal screening.
* Contact potential participants and provide study information as appropriate.
* Help maintain screening and enrollment goals while ensuring that eligibility decisions remain based strictly on protocol requirements.

 **Qualifications Required:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable interacting with patients in a professional and compassionate manner.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and studies simultaneously.
* Basic proficiency with computers, electronic medical records, and web\-based systems.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle protected health information appropriately.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with investigators and the research team.

**We are a proud work\-from\-office company. If you're ready to work on\-site in a dynamic, global company, we'd love to hear from you.**

**About Us**

PrismHR is the leading payroll, benefits, and HR software for Human Resource Outsourcing (HRO) organizations, including Professional Employer Organizations (PEOs) and Administrative Service Organizations (ASOs). Powering more than 80,000\+ companies, 2\.5 million worksite employees, and $85 billion in payroll processed annually, PrismHR is the most efficient, reliable, and scalable software solution to help PEOs and ASOs grow and prosper. The PrismHR platform is a complete, integrated HR solution supporting the full "hire\-to\-retire” lifecycle of HR services. And PrismHR provides a wide range of additional resources that go beyond just technology and support: PrismHR SEEDS sales and marketing program, the annual PrismHR LIVE Conference, and numerous learning opportunities throughout the year are all designed specifically to help PrismHR customers grow their business.

**Position Summary**

The Account Manager is responsible for the oversight and ongoing management of their assigned clients. The Account Manager works with sales and the support teams to implement new or renewing accounts, ensuring that a high service level is met. The Account Manager will also work with high\-level, key employees to maintain the ongoing client relationships. Being extremely knowledgeable about group benefits, having excellent problem resolution and negotiation skills is key. The Account Manager must also be personable, maintain a high\-level of professionalism and be able to travel for client meetings.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and conduct the implementation for new and renewing clients.
* Coordinate strategy meetings and document collection with Business Consultant.
* Market, analyze, and negotiate benefits and rates for all coverages.
* Request renewal from carrier.
* Conduct pre\-renewal and renewal meetings (in person or via Zoom).
* Negotiate renewals with carriers. Quote open market when necessary.
* Deliver final renewal to client and finalize benefit selections.
* Obtain applications and monitor benefit administration portals.
* Ensure everything is submitted in a timely manner (at minimum 15 days prior to the effective date)
* Perform first bill audits and host a meeting with client to discuss how the OE went.
* Ensure a high level of customer retention and satisfaction by building relationships with key contacts.
* Ensure high levels of service are delivered to ALL clients:
* High\-level of professionalism and customer service to employees.
* Provide 24\-hour response times to requests, if resolution is not able to be obtained within 24 hours make sure to keep lines of communication open with client by providing status updates.
* Education is key for all employees and key contact.
* Ensure all clients are compliant with their benefits, contributions, etc.
* Select filings of compliance documents
* COBRA

**Marginal Functions**

* Build, maintain and promote relationships with team members, peers across disciplines, and all other company team members ensuring effective coordination of communications and services affecting clients.
* Attend webinars and training to stay up to date on best practices related to the company and department.
* Complete projects and other duties as assigned by supervisor.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Personal qualities of integrity and credibility.
* Must be able to work individually and as part of a team.
* Must be able to use the utmost discretion in all presentations/correspondence and communication for staff, clients and all leadership.
* Intermediate (or higher) knowledge of Microsoft Office and Adobe.
* Work requires professional, written, and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multi\-task and prioritize to meet stated deadlines.
* Knowledge of employee benefits, compliance, and payroll.
* Must be able to read, analyze, and interpret SBC, technical procedures, insurance regulations, and governmental regulations.
* Ability to respond effectively to the most sensitive inquiries and complaints.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
